title: Apply request
description: POST /apply. One subject's resolved desired state. The add-on decodes it strictly. Request identity: identity/apply.json.

contract_version.description: The wire contract major both ends speak. Contract 2: equality-checked, a mismatch is refused with CONTRACT_VERSION_MISMATCH.

call_id.description: The deduplication token; a replay with the same identity is answered from the first call.

email.description: What a username is derived from, only when an account must be created.

fingerprint.description: The target state the plan was computed against; verified at the add-on immediately before the write.
